source.title: Meta Muse can do your Black Friday shopping at Walmart
source.text: Muse can find Walmart’s Black Friday deals so that you don’t have to. | Image: Walmart Walmart will now let Meta's Muse shop on your behalf, allowing the AI agent to find and purchase Black Friday deals via Walmart's Sparky AI assistant. The retail giant is rolling out a live implementation of the Agent Gateway it announced last month , which helps AI agents find relevant products for you without sharing your purchase history, according to Walmart. Muse can make purchases through Walmart's "Agent Profiles," which provide a dedicated space for agent activity within your Walmart customer account. These profiles also allow you to set spending limits, approve purchases, and check the purchase history of everything bought by Mu … Read the full story at The Verge.
